notes: Patterns match the complete glTF action name, never a mesh or bone name.
Exterior aileron, elevator, rudder and spoiler animation refs require the packaged native bootstrap and FlyWithLua hydraulic surface driver.

FBW Anims_Exterior.xml defines aileron/elevator/rudder clips as signed -1..1 and spoiler clips as 0..65 source degrees; the hydraulic driver preserves the existing clipped native spoiler degree mapping.
Main gear clips combine deployment (first half) and compression (second half). Deployment mapping intentionally uses only the first half until compression is independently implemented.

Primary landing-gear doors use explicit source samples: closed at either deployment endpoint and open through the middle of travel. Auxiliary body and aft nose doors remain open with the extended gear.
Unknown animations retain source rest pose. Suggested custom dataref names in reports are planning metadata and are not emitted into OBJ files.

Native stabilizer degrees are positive leading-edge UP, not aircraft nose-up trim. These 21 values are the signed world-X angles of the pinned FBW trim quaternion keys relative to source fraction 0.5; the authored travel is asymmetric, not +/-10 degrees. Geometry follows actual incidence one-for-one without changing the flight model.
